name: Shopware
description: Open source commerce platform for building and running online stores.
composeOverride:
# Generated by McHarbor App Store
services:
  {{serviceName}}:
    image: {{image}}
    container_name: {{containerName}}
    restart: unless-stopped
{{ports}}
    environment:
      TZ: {{env.TZ}}
      DATABASE_URL: "mysql://shopware:{{env.MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD}}@{{serviceName}}-mariadb:3306/shopware"
      MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD: {{env.MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD}}
      APP_SECRET: {{env.APP_SECRET}}
    volumes:
      - {{appDataPath}}/data:/var/www/html
    depends_on:
      - {{serviceName}}-mariadb
  {{serviceName}}-mariadb:
    image: mariadb:11
    container_name: {{serviceName}}-mariadb
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      MYSQL_DATABASE: shopware
      MYSQL_USER: shopware
      MYSQL_PASSWORD: {{env.MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD}}
      MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD: {{env.MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD}}
    volumes:
      - {{appDataPath}}/mariadb:/var/lib/mysql
